name: run-apparel-viewer-monorepo
description: RUN APPAREL — QR-deep-linkable 3D apparel product viewer (viewer + Payload CMS + asset pipeline)

scripts.seed:assets: pnpm --filter @run-apparel/asset-pipeline start placeholders --out output/placeholders && pnpm --filter @run-apparel/asset-pipeline start merge --meshopt --out output/n001.glb output/placeholders/n001-wine.glb=N001-WINE output/placeholders/n001-blush.glb=N001-BLUSH output/placeholders/n001-butter.glb=N001-BUTTER output/placeholders/n001-lime.glb=N001-LIME output/placeholders/n001-black.glb=N001-BLACK && pnpm --filter @run-apparel/asset-pipeline start validate output/n001.glb --expect N001-WINE,N001-BLUSH,N001-BUTTER,N001-LIME,N001-BLACK
